title: Build 1 result: five MSPs committed, recorder Lane 0 failed, resume once
context: mitosis build 1 (plan 8d0092f535f4) exited 10. Lane 0 of the recorder MSP built all four Steps but returned failed: an extra assertion it added (expect(tester.hasRunningAnimations, isFalse) at recorder_surface_test.dart:388) is red because at exactly 3000 ms the animation has not yet ended, and the pre-edit hook locked that test file. Its hand-off says deleting the line is the whole fix. recorder and voice-peaks are blocked by it. windows-reminder-guard (gate 8 pass, 1 inert on the Unchanged 16.34 test), settings-panel-colours, day-card-playback, restart-splash-text and release-notes committed with clean reconcile.
options: Run run.zsh --resume once, so a fresh Worker finishes Lane 0 from its hand-off and voice-peaks then builds
Fix the test line in the worktree from the main thread
Treat the recorder MSP as a hard failure now
option_reasons: The pipeline gives an MSP mitosis did not commit one --resume; a fresh Worker session is not hook-locked and the hand-off names the one-line fix and the unfinished red proofs and suite.
Editing a Lane's worktree from the main thread bypasses mitosis's gate and the Worker rules, and leaves the red proofs and suite unrun.
The pipeline counts it as a hard failure only after the one resume also fails to commit.
outcome: Resume once with run.zsh --resume; the five committed MSPs are kept and go to review after the resume.
